Birgitte Rühmann (also spelled Birgitte Rühman in some official documents) is a Danish nurse and a key administrative figure in the national clinical quality databases for acute surgery. She serves as the head nurse (*oversygeplejerske*) and the representative for the data controller authority at the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP) Knowledge Center [^src1]. In this capacity, she acts as the primary contact person for both RKKP [^src3] and the [[sundhedsvaesenets-kvalitetsinstitut|Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut]] [^src2], ensuring data responsibility, compliance, and proper registration processes within the databases. 

Furthermore, Rühmann is a member of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]] (Acute Surgery Database Steering Committee) [^src1]. Her involvement in the steering committee and her role as the central contact point highlight her importance in the governance, data validation, and operational oversight of the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB), which monitors the treatment quality for high-risk acute abdominal surgical patients across Denmark's regions.
